queue.title: Don't Be Motivated. Be Disciplined.

voiceover_script.full_text: 3am. No alarm going off. No one clapping. No one watching. Motivation left the moment it got hard — it always does. It's a feeling, and feelings don't show up on schedule. Discipline isn't loud. It isn't a mood. It's the decision you already made, so you don't have to make it again tonight. You're not here because you feel like it. You're here because you built a system that doesn't ask how you feel. Nobody's coming to save you. Get up. Again.

queue.seo_description: 3am, no motivation, no audience — just the decision to move anyway. A short cinematic monologue on why discipline beats motivation every time you don't feel like showing up. For anyone building the version of themselves nobody sees yet.
queue.sound_direction: Slowed hardtekk/phonk instrumental, minimal melodic content — heavy sub-kick and distorted bass building steadily under the spoken lines from 0:03 to 0:18, tension increasing but never overpowering the voiceover. Sound thins out through the 0:18-0:24 beat, then drops to near-silence (kick removed entirely, faint low drone only) under the final whispered payoff line at 0:24-0:30 so the line lands in near-quiet. No lyrics, no recognizable sample, CC0/library source only — matched by Agent 4.2.
queue.visual_direction: Mood/type needed (raw clips 1.mp4-60.mp4 not yet tagged by description; Agent 3.1 to match): dim, near-dark gym interior, pre-dawn/blue-hour lighting, single practical light source (phone flashlight, single overhead bulb, or window streetlight). Cold open: close-up on a hand silencing a phone alarm before it sounds, then hands tying shoelaces in low light. Follow with solitary-figure shots — empty weight room, one person alone on a bench or rack, no other people in frame, condensation/breath visible if available. Close on face or hands for the final payoff line (still or near-still frame, high contrast, desaturated/cool color grade). Avoid any clip with visible gym branding, other identifiable people, or bright/crowded settings — tone must stay isolated, cinematic, and low-key throughout.
